listing.name: Wipeout Pure (pure-recomp)
listing.summary: Register an independently permitted prepared Wipeout Pure Windows copy for your own US Greatest Hits v2.00 disc, keeping external saves, optional DLC and upstream maintenance separate.

steps.title: Complete the exact owned-disc setup upstream
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted complete pure-recomp Windows copy and your own Wipeout Pure US Greatest Hits UCUS-98612 version2.00 ISO. This guide covers only the known plain on-disc BOOT.BIN SHA-256 9033e4dd3433116eee2fd309f9c775e332e54da292d7a85075d3b4ccdb9b5750. The profile records encrypted EBOOT.BIN SHA-256 0228768504ea79edf5c2c5301e0c3fd3c4f1bfc32b6e59e2dd0de5fef8028453 as reference metadata; no separate EBOOT read/hash check is demonstrated by the selected BOOT path. It prepares the plain BOOT.BIN without a separate PSP decryption key. Different-region disc IDs are rejected. Upstream run_unknown_executables permits an unknown plain executable with the same accepted disc ID after a warning/interpreter route; that broader route is outside this guide. Complete the supported known-input first-run check/copy-or-in-place setup upstream; Portcove does not acquire, import, extract or compile the original.

steps.title: Attach the documented Windows player
steps.instruction: Select Wipeout Pure.exe with the complete creating Wipeout Pure package directory as working directory and no arguments for normal play after setup. The exact v0.2.0 package README documents that entry; the bundle recipe copies the native PureNative build to that name. Keep all supplied DLLs, fonts/resources and notices together. The source entry delegates to the normal PortableKit game path in the same program; source patches and an uninspected package are not a binary/source certificate. Do not attach a build script, Mac bundle, replay tool or setup command.

steps.title: Keep setup and restart paths separate
steps.instruction: --install is an upstream setup operation, including a command form that exits after preparing an image; complete it outside this attachment. The System menu also owns save import/export, backup, DLC installation and setup-again/restart choices. Close every actual player and any successor before maintenance or another attachment; registration status does not prove successor adoption or termination. No new Core environment/shell/compiler infrastructure or private-runner bypass is introduced.

steps.title: Review Play and preserve the whole data folder
steps.instruction: Review and consent to this exact executable, working directory and literal arguments, then request Play separately. The documented Windows profile is %APPDATA%/pure-recomp/PureNative; preserve the actual effective root and existing PURE_DATA_DIR/custom locations too. Keep EBOOT.ELF, copied disc.iso or its in-place original path, settings.ini, ms0/PSP/SAVEDATA/, DLC, texture packs, pipeline_cache.bin, logs/screenshots, backups and temporary files with the creating runtime. Do not assume deleting the player folder removes all state, or infer Portcove PSP/PPSSPP or cross-version save compatibility from upstream claims.

steps.title: Retain optional-content and runtime ownership
steps.instruction: Original US DLC packs and optional external HD texture packs are separate player-supplied material, not a prerequisite or a grant supplied by this registration. Preserve their actual original/mod/profile roots; do not convert European/Japanese packs or fetch the third-party HD pack through this guide. Project GPL2-or-later, PortableKit MIT, FFmpeg LGPL and other component notices apply separately from Sony/game/art rights. Upstream/user owns all preparation, runtime replacement and recovery. Close actual sessions, keep the old working copy and data, then review/relink changed selected bytes. Removing registration preserves all external files; no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion is offered.
